result: The "gap score" is calculated as the difference between the PFIS and FRAI values for each facility. "Serious system strain" is defined by a Resource-Demand Differential (RDD) value greater than 1.0.

    ROUND((AVG(CASE asd.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 END) - AVG(CASE f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END))::numeric, 4) as gap_score

       AVG(CASE f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END) > 1.0

WITH facility_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey,
        AVG(CASE asd.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 END) as pfis,
        AVG(CASE f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END) as frai
    FROM facilities f
    JOIN encounters e ON f.fackey = e.facid
    JOIN patients p ON e.patref = p.patkey
    JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON e.abref = ab.abkey
    JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON ab.abkey = asd.asdkey
    GROUP BY f.fackey
)
SELECT fackey, pfis - frai as gap_score
FROM facility_scores
WHERE pfis - frai > 1.0
